title: Coverage and origin status must advance through a monotonic promotion matrix
purpose: Prevent M-004, M-005, and M-006 from being promoted, demoted, or classified absent through prose drift when coverage evidence and candidate predicates evolve independently.

observed: CM-1021 defines the predicates required to verify an identifier origin and preserves unresolved status when any predicate fails or is unknown.
CM-1022 defines the evidence required for exhaustive coverage and forbids absence promotion when any coverage domain is incomplete.
The active queue still lists exhaustive history coverage and immutable origin provenance as unresolved acceptance criteria for M-004, M-005, and M-006.
No inspected continuity record defines the allowed joint transitions between coverage_status and origin_status.
inferred: Coverage completeness and candidate validity are independent axes; combining them into a single prose conclusion permits accidental status drift.
A monotonic transition matrix allows new evidence to refine a claim without erasing prior rejection reasons, coverage limits, or provenance edges.
proposed: Represent each disputed identifier as the product of coverage_state and origin_state.
Permit origin_status=verified only from a candidate that passes every CM-1021 predicate, regardless of whether global coverage is exhaustive.
Permit origin_status=unlocated_after_exhaustive_coverage only when CM-1022 coverage_status=exhaustive and every retained candidate is rejected with immutable reasons.
Require every transition to cite the prior state, triggering evidence, retained artifact locator, and falsification route.
superseded: Treating unresolved and unlocated as interchangeable labels.
Allowing a negative search result to move an identifier directly from unresolved to unlocated.
Overwriting a prior candidate rejection when later evidence changes only one predicate or coverage domain.
unresolved: No exhaustive ref-and-history manifest has been retained.
No origin candidate for M-004, M-005, or M-006 has passed every CM-1021 predicate.
The originating decision log, language lexicon, project document, or approved chat-history assignment source remains unlocated.

forbidden_transitions: Any transition to unlocated_after_exhaustive_coverage from unknown, partial, or complete_single_client coverage.
Any transition to verified without all CM-1021 predicates passing.
Any transition that deletes prior candidate evaluations, coverage limits, or immutable locators.
Any transition from verified to unlocated; contradictory evidence must create a disputed_verified state in a new revision rather than erase history.
Any retroactive creation, reassignment, or renumbering of M-004, M-005, or M-006.
falsification_routes: Produce a valid origin that CM-1021 accepts but this matrix forbids from reaching verified.
Produce an exhaustive CM-1022 manifest for which the matrix still incorrectly blocks an unlocated classification after every candidate is rejected.
Demonstrate a permitted transition that loses a prior immutable locator, rejection reason, or coverage limitation.
Show that one current projection is inconsistent with retained repository evidence.
